### Repository Layout
*~45,000 tokens/session saved*
- The `model` and `xml-parser` Gradle modules in this repo (AndroidStudioProjects/Scythebill) point via `srcDirs` at source trees in a SEPARATE checkout: `~/Developer/scythebill-git/birdlist/model/src/main/java/...` and `~/Developer/scythebill-git/birdlist/xml-parser/src/main/java/...`. There is no `model/src` or `xml-parser/src` directory inside AndroidStudioProjects/Scythebill itself — searching there fails with 'No such file or directory'. Always grep/read model & xml-parser business logic from `~/Developer/scythebill-git/birdlist/...`.
- Android-side app code (Compose UI, cache, DI) lives under `app/src/main/java/com/scythebill/birdlist/android/`.

### Frequently-Touched Files
*~35,178 tokens/session saved*
- `app/src/main/java/com/scythebill/birdlist/android/MainActivity.kt`, `ui/query/QueryBuilderScreen.kt`/`QueryViewModel.kt`, `ui/taxonomy/TaxonomyBrowseScreen.kt`/`SpeciesDetailScreen.kt`, and `cache/SightingCacheBuilder.kt`/`CacheEntities.kt`/`CacheDao.kt` are the app's largest, most-edited files — read them fully once per session rather than re-reading in chunks across many edits.

### Environment / Tooling
*~8,000 tokens/session saved*
- The bundled `find` wrapper (rtk) does not support compound predicates like `-not`/`-exec`; use plain `find` (or `/usr/bin/find`) directly when those are needed.
- In zsh, quote glob patterns passed to grep, e.g. `grep --include="*.kt"` — unquoted `--include=*.kt` errors with 'no matches found'.
- Verify Kotlin compiles with `./gradlew :app:compileDebugKotlin -q 2>&1 | tail -100` before considering an edit done.
